items.title: A surjective etale chart gives an etale equivalence relation with a coequalizer diagram
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an algebraic space F over S and a surjective etale morphism f : U -> F from a scheme, with R = U x_F U, the map j : R -> U x_S U defines an equivalence relation, its two projections are etale, and the diagram R => U -> F is a coequalizer in the category of fppf sheaves (source lines 1387-1407). The proof identifies R(T) with the pairs of U(T) with equal image under f, reads etaleness off f, and then verifies that U -> F is a surjection of sheaves by pulling back an arbitrary section along the covering V = T x_{xi,F,f} U, after which the coequalizer statement follows from surjectivity.
